old man farmer occupation from Nalgonda presented to the op complaining of lower back pain since a week, reduced appetite, facial puffiness and shortness of breath grade 3 since one week\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E20 years ago patient had an occupational accident where a bullock cart ran over his abdomen then underwent splenectomy and 4 prbc transfusion\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 years ago while farming he was wounded on the right dorsum of the foot which did not heal completely for nearly 2 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eon investigations low hemoglobin was found to be the main cause for his delayed wound healing and was referred to another Hospital,In Khammam, on further investigations – RFT, USG he was told to have a kidney infection due to SEPSIS from the ULCER.(?AKI due to SEPSIS) whete underwent 2 prbc transfusion prior operating at the wound site\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOctober, 2021 –\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehe was apparently alright when he developed-FEVER, COLD, PEDAL EDEMA (PITTING TYPE) , GENERALISED WEAKNESS OF THE BODY.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was then taken to a hospital in Suryapet where he was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease and hypertension.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EINVESTIGATIONS DONE- SERUM CREAT, CBP, USG ABDOMEN \u0026amp; PELVIS, CUE\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETreatment given here – injection erythropoietin , tab.nodosis , tab.vitamin D3, tab.neurobion forte, tab.paracetamol\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe symptoms subsided in 3 to 4 days.
